definitions.explanation: The opening in the face used for eating and speaking.

examples.japanese: {口|くち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}けて→開ける：00563_akeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。

examples.english: Does this dish suit your taste?
examples.notes: 口に合う = to suit one's taste

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{口|くち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{堅|かた}い→硬い：01116_katai⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦なので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{秘密|ひみつ}→秘密：02504_himitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{話|はな}して→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}→大丈夫：00772_daijoubu⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: He is a person who can keep secrets, so it's okay to tell him secrets.

examples.japanese: ⟦{走|はし}った→走る：00519_hashiru⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{口|くち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{乾|かわ}いて→乾く：00786_kawaku⟧⟦{喉|のど}→喉：00977_nodo⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{渇|かわ}く→渇く：10965_kawaku⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{飲|の}みます→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: After running, my mouth gets dry and I get thirsty, so I drink a lot of water.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{口|くち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えて→見える：01165_mieru⟧⟦しまう→仕舞う：03064_shimau⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、{口|くち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食|た}べ{物|もの}→食べ物：02890_tabemono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}み{込|こ}んで→飲み込む：04403_nomikomu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{話|はな}しましょう→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: When you talk while eating, people can see the food in your mouth, so let's swallow the food before talking.

notes:
IDIOMATIC EXPRESSIONS:
- {口|くち}に{合|あ}う: to suit one's taste
- {口|くち}が{堅|かた}い: tight-lipped, discreet
- {口|くち}が{軽|かる}い: loose-lipped, indiscreet
- {口|くち}を{出|だ}す: to interfere, butt in
- {口|くち}を{聞|き}く: to speak, to mediate

EXTENDED MEANINGS:
{口|くち} also means "opening" and appears in many compound words:
- {入|い}り{口|ぐち}: entrance
- {出|で}{口|ぐち}: exit
- {窓口|まどぐち}: service window, counter
- {改札口|かいさつぐち}: ticket gate

Note: Reading changes to ぐち in compounds.
